titulo: Naming ten as the end time
caption:
Naming ten as the end time

Stay as long as you like, the host says, and he means it so much that he can't relax. She names ten, and he can.

Saying when you will leave takes one sentence, and the host stops guessing how long the evening is.

For whoever tells the host when they plan to leave.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a big clock in the middle that says now. A royal blue block figure with wide white eyes on the left fidgets and says stay as long as you like! A ink-black block figure with white eyes on the right says I'll head out at ten. The clock changes to 10:00, the royal blue one stops fidgeting and says perfect. thank you! and both turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me, naming my end time.
